item.title: Track Premiere: Void of Light – “Mirrorings”

item.title: Video Premiere: Deteriorot – “Fallen Misery”
item.description: There are death metal bands who chased trends. And then there are bands like Deteriorot—who stayed in the shadows long enough to become part of them. Watch them emerge in the video for "Fallen Misery." The post Video Premiere: Deteriorot – “Fallen Misery” appeared first on Decibel Magazine.

item.title: Track Premiere: Crippled Black Phoenix – “Colder and Colder”
item.description: Crippled Black Phoenix's new track is catchy and immediate, but also endlessly mournful and gloomy, it's the soundtrack to your next rainy day. Tune in to "Colder and Colder" now. item.title: Video Premiere: Red Sands – “System”
item.description: Mexico City modern metallers Red Sands released their new six-track EP, Evocations, back in January. Today they reveal this video is for the track, "System," a song the band say is at the heart of the recent release. The post Video Premiere: Red Sands – “System” appeared first on Decibel Magazine.
